**What changed:** newer builds for the same Minecraft version, boot-tested on the runner.

- server: paper 1.21.10 build 130
- plugin: Chunky 1.4.40

**What it means for players:** Nothing to do for them. When this deploys, the server restarts once (an in-game countdown warns anyone online) and runs the newer builds: bug and security fixes, same Minecraft version.

**What to do:** Nothing: the required `server / gate` check re-verifies every changed entry against the upstream APIs, then this merges by itself (automation.auto_merge) and the merge deploys.
